title: Sample Complexity for the 2-Gromov-Wasserstein Distance
summary: In this paper, we study the sample complexity of the empirical plug-in estimator for the $2$-Gromov-Wasserstein distance $D_2$ between compactly supported probability measures on Euclidean spaces. Let $μ$ and $ν$ be supported on compact subsets of $\mathbb{R}^{d_x}$ and $\mathbb{R}^{d_y}$, respectively, and let $\widehatμ_n$ and $\widehatν_n$ be their empirical measures based on independent samples of size $n$. We prove that \[ \mathbb{E}\left|D_2^2(\widehatμ_n,\widehatν_n)-D_2^2(μ,ν)\right| \lesssim n^{-2/((d_x\wedge d_y)\vee 4)} (\log n)^{\mathbf 1_{\{d_x\wedge d_y=4\}}}. \] This rate is…
